archive_policy: 3.0 and 3.1 evaluators remain frozen. 3.2 source assertions, antecedents and field-exposure observations are retained in hashed assessment inputs and replayed.

field_exposure.source: OpenAlex first-page meta.count for one fixed QueryPlan.english_query and each completed publication year
field_exposure.budget: 6 to 10 first-page requests; max_results=1; no discovery corpus denominator
field_exposure.units: Candidate numerator: unique study families. Denominator: indexed works returned by a fixed lexical query. This is an explicitly limited exposure proxy, not worldwide coverage or identical research-study units.
field_exposure.unknown: Errors, missing totals, zero exposures and candidate counts exceeding exposure prevent relative-growth decisions. Missing is never zero.
field_exposure.provenance: Exact query, one-year date bounds, source-reported total/page metadata, observed timestamp and canonical content hash

growth.windows: Adjacent three-year windows among the final six completed years; older years provide age context
growth.zero_baseline: Raw ratio is undefined; Jeffreys-smoothed ratio uses 0.5 pseudo-counts only for descriptive ranking; exact conditional interval can be unbounded
growth.uncertainty: 95% equal-tail exact conditional Poisson rate-ratio interval via Clopper-Pearson beta quantiles. Does not include indexing, selection, query or overdispersion uncertainty. Stored bounds use12 significant digits and symmetric beta tails to avoid cancellation; confirmation requires lower bound>1+1e-10.
growth.emerging_gate: R>=10, two active recent years, raw ratio>=1.5 (or zero baseline), lower interval bound>1, recent field-relative rates nondecreasing and final rate strictly increasing, absolute recent transitions nonnegative

positive_admission: reviewed novelty or archived same-study author assertion of a novel mechanism plus an experimental result

categories.weak_signal_candidate: Automatic hypothesis only: author novelty assertion, first observed within three years, baseline zero, 2<=R<10, rising final field-relative rate and nondecreasing recent rates/counts. A Poisson interval including one is displayed, not interpreted as confirmed growth.
categories.emerging_candidate: Automatic hypothesis only: first observed within six years plus every relative-growth gate. Author assertions are not independent novelty verification.
categories.early_signal: Same sparse eligibility plus expert-reviewed new mechanism/combination (novelty>=75)
categories.confirmed_trend: Same emerging eligibility plus expert-reviewed novelty>=50
categories.insufficient_evidence: Missing or unmet required evidence, age, coverage or dynamics
categories.renewed_interest: Expert-reviewed established/renamed mechanism with field-relative growth
categories.established_topic: Expert-reviewed established/renamed mechanism without field-relative growth
categories.declining: Final decline without a preceding rise

signal_priority: Only eligible positive categories: 100*clip((7-observed_age)/6,0,1)*(clip(log2(relative_ratio)/3,0,1)*persistence*specificity)^(1/3), where specificity is an admission gate equal to 1 and persistence=active_recent_years/3*nonnegative_transitions/2. No deployment bonus or raw-volume tie break.
score_interpretation: Signal priority is an uncalibrated ordering heuristic, never a probability. Existing priority_score and its missing-component bounds retain their descriptive legacy meaning and do not determine 3.2 TOP ranking.
validation_status: Regression and archived-input replay verified; independent scientific precision, recall and predictive lead time require separately labelled data and dated snapshots. Current index counts are reconstructed history, not strict historical as-of observations.
